div.p: This case-sensitive code system https://fhir-ig.digitalhealth.gov.ng/CodeSystem/ng-alert-code-cs defines the following codes:

tr.td: A clinical contraindication relevant to a planned intervention, medication, immunization, or procedure.
A known or suspected allergy or intolerance risk requiring attention.
A possible clinically significant interaction involving one or more medications.
Potentially duplicative medication or treatment has been identified.
A scheduled medication or immunization dose was not administered as expected.
A scheduled medication or immunization dose is currently due.
A scheduled medication or immunization dose is overdue.
A clinical or diagnostic result is outside its expected or acceptable range.
A critical clinical or diagnostic result requires urgent review or action.
A clinically relevant diagnostic result is still pending.
An infection, exposure, or transmission risk requires attention or precautions.
The subject requires isolation or specific infection-prevention precautions.
A safeguarding concern requires review or protective action.
The subject may have more than one health record.
Demographic, biometric, or identifier information may not match the intended subject.
A data-quality, completeness, consistency, or record-integrity issue requires review.
A consent directive limits access, disclosure, or use of the subject's information.
The subject requires clinical, public-health, or administrative follow-up.
Referral to another provider, facility, service, or level of care is required.
A statutory, programmatic, or public-health report or notification must be submitted.
The subject's information or clinical status requires urgent review.
An alert type not represented by another code in this code system.

description.value: Common alert types used by Nigerian health information systems and represented using the Nigeria Alert Flag profile.
